role.title: Senior Software Engineer
role.description: Played a pivotal role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable microservices for AI-powered chatbots, optimizing system performance, and enhancing automation capabilities.

contributions.item: Designed and developed JSON-based Spring Boot microservices for various chatbot solutions.
Customized the Hubot-Natural project to enable chatbot training via YAML files, integrating seamlessly with Rocket.Chat as the backend.
Implemented a NoSQL-driven architecture, storing chat conversations, intents, and attributes using MongoDB (NoSQLBooster as client).
Built containerized deployments, creating Docker images and deploying services on Kubernetes to ensure scalability and fault tolerance.
Developed and tested microservices using Postman and optimized APIs for performance and reliability.
Worked with enterprise technologies, including CXF-based SOAP web services, Apache Camel Routing, ActiveMQ, and JBoss Fuse 6.1, while leveraging Spring 4 as the core framework.
Followed Agile development methodologies, ensuring rapid iterations, high-quality releases, and continuous improvements.

role.techStack: Spring Boot | MongoDB | Docker | Kubernetes | Apache Camel | ActiveMQ | JBoss Fuse 6.1 | SOAP/REST | Agile
